title: Reinstatement, Sale and Deficiency Figures by Tier — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
After a repossession on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the tier sets the company reinstatement window and count, the relationship days-past-due limit for a discretionary reinstatement, the company minimum time from the notice of intent to sell to the sale, the surplus refund time, the minimum deficiency settlement and the charge-off period.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after repossession within which a company reinstatement must be completed | 10 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 21 | 21 |
| Company-discretion reinstatements over the life of the contract (maximum) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Days past due on another Kestrel account at which a discretionary reinstatement is withheld | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Company minimum calendar days from the notice of intent to sell to the sale | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Calendar days after the sale within which a surplus is refunded | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum lump-sum settlement, percent of the deficiency balance | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Calendar days after the sale before an unpaid deficiency is charged off | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

## Notes

- Tier 1 and Tier 1+ allow a 21-day window and 2 company reinstatements; Tier 5 allows 10 days and 1.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a lump sum of 60 percent of a USD 5000.00 deficiency is USD 3000.00.
